overview: You wrote one page of the third act after Tuesday's shortened greeting. The men heard a false death and went home. The ground is his, and the men are not. You set the pen down, short of the ground speech. The tables stayed untouched.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page, and set the pen down.
